correctStatements.text: At 23:40 Devika relayed user complaints that push notifications were arriving about 20 minutes late.
At 23:44 Matteo saw the notify-high queue depth at 310 thousand messages and growing.
At 23:47 Aiko found the consumer pods in CrashLoopBackOff after 6 restarts.
Aiko traced the crash to a null device token in a payload from the new onboarding flow.
At 23:58 Bashir decided to add a null guard and divert bad payloads to the dead letter queue.
At 00:09 Bashir rolled the patched consumer out to all pods.
Devika noted the delays hit both iOS and Android while the web push channel was unaffected.
At 00:20 Matteo saw the backlog fall to 90 thousand with consumers keeping up.
At 00:41 Matteo reported the queue back at normal levels of under 500 messages.
Aiko will validate device tokens at the onboarding API.
Matteo will change paging to trigger on queue age above 5 minutes rather than queue depth.
Bashir recapped that a malformed payload crashed the notification consumers and delayed pushes for roughly an hour.
